swimming_pool.evidence: Large rectangular white/gray pool-shaped cover with steps and loungers along one side on the big lawn west of the house; a separate blue pool at upper right likely belongs to a neighboring lot.

play_equipment.evidence: Frame-like swing set or play structure near a curved retaining wall at the top of the lawn, though it may sit on an adjacent lot.

detached_structure.evidence: Small gray-roofed outbuilding with a patio beside the pool cover at the left edge of the lawn.

signals.notes: Ownership of the central lawn is ambiguous: it is a large open lawn with a covered pool and outbuilding, likely tied to the gray-roofed house to the east, with dense tree canopy to the south and west.
